title: Canonical four-graph retrieval regression suite
description: Stable locator checks for the repository-local GraphRAG layer. Each case checks retrieval of an existing canonical graph record, not the truth of the record's scientific content.

cases.query: original joint relative cycle signed global intersection vector
cases.rationale: The active CPT navigation policy names this canonical Gate-1 open problem as the present blocker; retrieval must keep the locator discoverable.
The hypercomplex graph's basis-invariant diagnostic remains an explicit open problem and should be retrieved by its documented language.
The legacy graph distinguishes independently timestamped records from retrospective integrity claims; the canonical claim locator must remain findable.
The locality audit keeps this finite-model claim separate from broader theory; retrieval must retain the scoped canonical claim locator.

cases.query: real corridor kappa transverse unique continuous selector
cases.rationale: The P1 handoff is the scoped real fixed-lambda root theorem, not a nonreal Weyl or RAQ result.

cases.query: p zero complex tail enclosure Volterra prerequisite actual recessive endpoint
cases.rationale: P4 must locate the theorem prerequisite before any endpoint solver or spectral promotion.

cases.query: actual selected nonzero p m boundary values Stieltjes Livsic spectral measure unitary fiber transform
cases.rationale: The spectral-measure locator records that a finite proxy is not a spectral theorem.

cases.query: Ragnarok killed numbered phase execution containment historical runner
cases.rationale: The circuit breaker must remain retrievable as an execution boundary rather than research evidence.

cases.query: finite cutoff nonreal Weyl proxy VALID_RUN Green Lagrange evidence
cases.rationale: The result evidence is a stable provenance locator for the finite proxy only.

cases.query: raw c nonreal Weyl proxy evidence snapshot sha256 artifact provenance
cases.rationale: The evidence snapshot artifact provides the hash-pinned compact provenance record.

cases.query: Singular Weyl Titchmarsh theory distributional potentials Eckhardt Gesztesy Nichols Teschl
cases.rationale: The primary operator-theory source must be locatable without conflating it with a local endpoint proof.

cases.query: 현재 Gate 1 병목 원래 joint relative cycle 부호 있는 global intersection vector
cases.rationale: Korean project navigation should retrieve the same canonical current Gate-1 blocker.

cases.query: admissible choice invariance same mechanism two independent in graph consumers promotion boundary
cases.rationale: The repository-wide promotion boundary must be retrievable as policy rather than evidence for an effect.
Tokens absent from the selected graph must produce an explicit abstention, not token-hash collision results.

guidance: This suite is a retrieval, boundary, and abstention regression baseline, not a scientific evaluation, citation-entailment audit, or execution authorization.
Add a positive case only when its locator, rank bound, forbidden boundaries, and wording are stable and source-backed; add a negative case only for a reviewed failure mode.
Run the revision diff before accepting a material ontology or retrieval change, then inspect rank movement and raw graph context manually.
